entities.name: Solon
aliases: Scholar, Athlete, and Champion of Oxus
entities.description: A scholar, athlete and champion of the polis Oxus, sent into the sea god's labyrinth to retrieve Thassa's bident, Dekella; he keeps a diary.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: The god of the sea, who appears to Solon in the Siren Sea and etches glowing patterns into his skin.

entities.name: Dekella
entities.description: Thassa's bident, the artifact Solon was sent to retrieve, seen shimmering in the depths of the blue hole.

entities.name: Praxitelius
entities.description: A man from whose body Solon recovered an enchanted dagger.

entities.name: Minotaur of the labyrinth
entities.description: A gigantic axe-wielding minotaur born into the labyrinth, slain by Solon.

entities.name: Naiads
entities.description: Emissaries of Thassa who call to Solon from the blue hole and carry him through the underground sea.

entities.name: The Labyrinth
entities.description: A vast, shifting maze with a center holding a blue hole, through which Solon seeks Dekella.

entities.name: Oxus
entities.description: Solon's polis, to which he plans to return.

entities.name: Siren Sea
entities.description: The sea entered by Solon and the naiads through the underground sea.

events.summary: Solon forges an arrowhead from the enchanted dagger taken from Praxitelius and makes an arrow.
events.quote: I also plan to forge an arrowhead from the tip of the enchanted dagger I recovered from the body of Praxitelius.

events.summary: Solon kills a hart with his homemade arrow and eats.
events.quote: I nocked my homemade arrow and shot without hesitation.

events.summary: Solon climbs a crumbled wall and maps his way to the center of the labyrinth.
events.quote: I was able to climb to the top.

events.summary: A minotaur attacks Solon; his knife only scratches it and he flees.
events.quote: The wound, however, was like a scratch to the beast

events.summary: Solon kills the minotaur with his one arrow through its neck.
events.quote: It sank straight into the monster's neck, cutting its braying short with a violent silence.

events.summary: Solon reaches the center, finds a salt-water blue hole, sees Dekella shimmering, and hears naiads calling.
events.quote: I believe it is Thassa's bident, Dekella.

events.summary: Solon dives into the blue hole and the naiads surround him with an air bubble.
events.quote: It was then that the naiads emerged from their hiding places and surrounded me with sweet voices that formed a bubble filled with air around my entire body.

events.summary: The naiads tow Solon through the underground sea into the Siren Sea.
events.quote: Eventually, after I know not how long, we entered the Siren Sea

events.summary: Thassa approaches, speaks to Solon and etches a glowing pattern into his skin before vanishing.
events.quote: She reached out to me with a spindly finger and drew a pattern of light over my entire body

events.summary: Solon wakes on a beach, realizes retrieving Dekella was a fool's errand, and resolves to return to his polis changed.
events.quote: I now realize that retrieving Dekella was always a fool's errand.

relations.note: Shot it in the neck with his arrow.

relations.quote: I am certain they are naiads, emissaries of Thassa herself.
I believe it is Thassa's bident, Dekella.
Diary of Solon—Scholar, Athlete, and Champion of Oxus
